title: ECP Runtime Observation (M3-RG0 — operational zone, NON-AUTHORITATIVE)
description: A runtime/operational state document of the trust store's operational zone (M3-RG0, 0.7.0, order §6/§9). Runtime observations record WHAT LATER HAPPENED (execution attempts observed, environment probes, status views) and are — by contract and by verification — NEVER a source of reference truth for WHAT WAS REGISTERED: authority_class is the const 'NON-AUTHORITATIVE', zone is the const 'operational', and verify_trust_store rejects any operational document lacking these markers or carrying an authoritative object type. The writer (record_runtime_observation) is the ONLY operational write path and it has no authority to touch the authoritative zone; there is no evidence-zone writer at 0.7.0. observation_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization with observation_hash removed (tampering detection for the log; the zone as a whole remains replaceable without affecting registered truth). Real observation material lives only in a private trust area; public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real operational material (private trust area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

registration_id.description: The ECP-TREG-… registration this observation refers to, or null for general runtime state. A non-null reference must resolve to an existing authoritative registration (fail-closed).

content.description: Free-form operational content; explicitly NON-AUTHORITATIVE — never consulted for registration truth.
